headline: Post-election GFC selloff
context: - 2008-11-11, -18.0%. The post-election GFC selloff. The base is November 4, election day, which was a local high.

headline: Slide into the March 2009 bear-market bottom
context: - 2009-03-03, -17.2%. The final slide into the March 6, 2009 bear-market low.

headline: Boeing publishes revised 787 schedule, first flight by end of 2009
context: Boeing published an updated 787 schedule on August 27, 2009 putting first flight by the end of 2009 and first delivery at the end of 2010, after the June 23, 2009 postponement for structural reasons. BA rose 8.4 percent on August 27 itself, from $47.82 to $51.82, which is the single largest day in the window and pins the cause to the announcement rather than to the market.

headline: S&P strips the US of its AAA rating, Black Monday 2011
context: Standard & Poor's downgraded US sovereign debt from AAA to AA+ on August 5, 2011, and on the next trading day, August 8, the S&P 500 fell 6.5 percent. BA is a high-beta industrial with heavy US government defense exposure, so it fell roughly two and a half times the index over the window. No Boeing-specific news is required to explain this one.
